_about: Dependencies held back ON PURPOSE, each with its reason and a date to look again. scripts/dependency-currency.ts reads this file: a newer major with no hold here fails the monthly check, and so does a hold past its look_again date or without a reason. Remove a hold when its move lands.

holds.name: typescript
holds.reason: TypeScript 7 is the native compiler; typescript-eslint 8.72 (the lint) supports only typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0. Move when typescript-eslint supports 7.

holds.name: @types/node
holds.reason: The types follow the Node major flo2-rvt runs on (22, as flo2.io's droplet does); a newer major describes APIs Node 22 lacks. Move with the runtime.

holds.name: Nice3point.Revit.Api.RevitAPI
holds.reason: The reference package's major is the Revit year, and the add-in targets the Autodesk.Revit+2024 engine, matching the models it reads. Move with the engine, before Revit 2024's engine deprecation on 2027-03-29.

holds.name: Autodesk.Forge.DesignAutomation.Revit
holds.reason: The bridge's major is the Revit year; 2024.0.2 is the bridge for the Autodesk.Revit+2024 engine. Move with the engine, before its deprecation on 2027-03-29.
